contexts.text: God hath heard their groaning () = aid... Groaning = grief on account of the endeavour of falsities to subjugate.
I have heard the groaning of the sons of Israel () = their grief from combat.
Still more when men groan, from a sincere heart (is it heard as a cry in Heaven).
The dove was heard as it were to moan...
That there will be no more heavenly delight and blessedness, is signified by all the glad in heart do groan (). AE 618:4.
Groaning and sighing over them () = aversion and grief for them.
Deficiency is signified by those who groan ().
As doves we moan in moaning () = the grief of the spiritual man.
Her priests groan () = that the affections of good are destroyed.
